name: Astro A50
author: leonavas
description: The Astro A50 headset (Gen 4 and Gen 5) in the bar: battery with low-battery alerts, equalizer, mic level, sidetone, noise gate and game/voice mix, without Windows.

barWidget.description: Headset battery in the bar. Click opens EQ, microphone and mix settings; middle click toggles the percentage; the wheel cycles EQ presets.

schema.label: Glyph
schema.description: Any Nerd Font character. Drawn while the headset is on or docked.

schema.label: Glyph while the headset is off
Show the percentage next to the glyph
schema.description: Middle click on the icon toggles this too.

schema.label: Hide the icon while the base station is unplugged
Dim the icon while the headset is off
Colour the icon while the battery is low
schema.description: The theme's yellow from the low threshold down, its urgent colour from the critical threshold down.

schema.label: Notify when the battery gets low and again when it gets critical
Battery check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar asks the base station while the panel is closed. An open panel checks every 3 seconds.
